intent: Count how many of the 8 sequenced reads in library_aln.bam were mapped to the reference (each read counted once), to report a mapping rate.
silent_error: samtools view -c -F 4 only removes unmapped records. Secondary (0x100) and supplementary (0x800) alignment records of multi-mapping and chimeric reads are also mapped records, so they are counted again: 10 'mapped reads' for a library of 8 reads (flagstat shows the same inflation as 'mapped' versus 'primary mapped'; documented in the samtools-flagstat man page). The correct count excludes flags 0x4, 0x100 and 0x800 (-F 2308). No message is printed; the number is just an integer.
